name: The Mithril Order
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Most of our recruits never make it to Booty Bay, adventurer. The shine of the insignia is enough to trigger the loot lust in even the staunchest of blacksmiths. Fools they be, as the insignia is a drop in the bucket compared to the wealth of items you'll see!

Find Galvan the Ancient and show him this pin. His residence is far to the north, between Zul Gurub and the Mosh'Ogg ogre mound.
narrative.objectives: Speak with Galvan the Ancient in Stranglethorn Vale.
narrative.offerRewardText: Ah, many years it has been since one has been worthy of the mithril order's initiation. We will start now!
narrative.requestItemsText: Hail! Come closer; show Galvan what you have.

chain.subtitle: 9 quests from level 40 to 45, 28,150 XP in all.

quests.name: The Old Ways
quests.objectiveText: Bring four Steel Breastplates and four Steel Plate Helms to Aturk the Anvil in Orgrimmar.

quests.name: The Origins of Smithing
quests.objectiveText: Bring six Golden Scale Bracers to Hank the Hammer in Stormwind.

quests.name: Booty Bay or Bust!
quests.objectiveText: Speak with McGavan in Booty Bay.

quests.name: In Search of Galvan
quests.objectiveText: Speak with McGavan in Booty Bay.

quests.name: The Mithril Order
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Galvan the Ancient in Stranglethorn Vale.

quests.name: Smelt On, Smelt Off
quests.objectiveText: Bring forty Mithril Bars and forty Iron Bars to Galvan the Ancient in Stranglethorn.

quests.name: The Great Silver Deceiver
quests.objectiveText: Bring forty Mithril Bars and five Truesilver Bars to Galvan the Ancient in Stranglethorn.

quests.name: The Art of the Imbue
quests.objectiveText: Bring forty Mithril Bars and four Citrines to Galvan the Ancient in Stranglethorn.

quests.name: Expert Blacksmith!
quests.objectiveText: Claim your reward from Galvan the Ancient!
